name: Angkor Period
description: From Jayavarman II's consecration in 802 to the fall of Angkor in 1431: the Khmer Empire at its height.

name: Post-Angkor Period
description: After Angkor was left as the capital in 1431, the court moved south: Longvek, Oudong, then Phnom Penh.

name: Pre-Angkor Period
description: Funan and Chenla, before Jayavarman II was consecrated on Phnom Kulen in 802.
